mapper.select: SELECT a.SERIE AS chassisSerie, a.CHNO AS chassisNo, a.VARIABLE AS variable, b.DESCRIPTION AS description, a.NEWVAL AS newVal, a.STA AS sta FROM HDOC_ADCA_MODIFICATION a LEFT JOIN HDOC_VARIABLES b ON a.VARIABLE = b.VARIABLE WHERE a.SERIE = #{chassisSerie} AND a.CHNO = #{chassisNo}

SELECT a.SERIE AS chassisSerie, a.CHNO AS chassisNo, a.VARIABLE AS variable, b.DESCRIPTION AS description, a.NEWVAL AS newVal, a.STA AS sta FROM HDOC_ADCA_MODIFICATION a LEFT JOIN HDOC_VARIABLES b ON a.VARIABLE = b.VARIABLE WHERE a.SERIE = #{chassisSerie} AND a.CHNO = #{chassisNo} AND a.NEWVAL = #{currentValue}
